$comment: The package identity Partner Center assigns, which is not a free choice.
Every value here is dictated by the Store once the app name is reserved,
and all three must match the reservation exactly or the upload is
rejected. They are found under Product Identity in Partner Center.
None of this is secret. The publisher id is on every Store listing, which
is why it lives in the repository rather than in a secret, where nobody
could review a change to it.
The __PLACEHOLDER__ values are deliberate. build.ps1 refuses to produce a
package for submission while any of them survive, because an MSIX built
with the wrong identity installs and runs perfectly and is then rejected
at the end of the upload, which is an expensive way to find a typo.

$howToFill.name: Partner Center > your app > Product management > Product identity > Package/Identity/Name
$howToFill.publisher: the same page, Package/Identity/Publisher. It is a full X.500 string beginning CN=, not your display name
$howToFill.publisherDisplayName: the same page, Package/Properties/PublisherDisplayName. This is the human one shown on the listing

name: __RESERVED_PACKAGE_NAME__
